entities.text: Wall: 1440 sprites with no bodies. The first third of the rows share one atlas (best case for batching), the second alternates textures, the last alternates blend, tint, alpha and z (worst case). 48 translucent washes add overdraw; 96 fades are destroyed over the first 25 s.
